full_prompt_en: A square semi-realistic anime illustration frames a young adult woman from the upper chest to just above the top of her short hair. She faces almost frontally, with her head turned a little toward the viewer's left. A full dark blue-black bob curves around her cheeks and ends near the jaw; uneven bangs skim her eyebrows. Thin amber-tinted glasses cross the bridge of her nose, their oversized rounded lenses dimming rather than hiding her direct brown-eyed gaze. Her lips part slightly, and her expression is quiet, watchful, and unsmiling. She wears a simple black crew-neck top with no visible decoration. The background is a soft out-of-focus brown-gray interior, possibly a wall or doorway, with faint diagonal light bands. Strong golden light from the upper right and behind catches individual outer hair strands, the right cheek edge, neck, and shoulder. The near side of the face and clothing remain in rich cool shadow, yet subtle warm reflected light preserves the nose, lips, and eyes. The hair has many fine luminous flyaways along the lit rim, while its interior stays a heavy, nearly solid blue-black shape. Facial anatomy is more modeled than in flat cel animation: smooth gradients give volume to the cheeks, nose, and mouth, but the eyes and lashes retain clear anime stylization. The composition has a calm central vertical silhouette set against one bright diagonal fall of light. No other figure, object, or readable text appears. The lighting carries most of the drama, turning an ordinary still pose into an intimate cinematic study of warm glow against cool darkness.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形半写实动漫插画从上胸画到短发顶端上方，框住一位年轻女子。她几乎正面，头略向观者左侧转。浓厚蓝黑短波波头沿脸颊弯下，停在下颌附近；不齐刘海轻扫眉毛。薄琥珀色镜片横过鼻梁，偏大的圆润镜片压低而非遮住她直视的棕眼。嘴唇微开，神情安静、警觉而无笑意。她穿简单黑圆领上衣，没有可见装饰。背景是失焦的棕灰室内，可能是墙或门道，带模糊斜向光带。强烈金色光从右上后方照到外缘单根发丝、右脸边、颈与肩。近侧脸和衣服留在浓厚冷影中，但微弱暖反光仍保留鼻、唇与眼。发的受光边有许多发亮细碎游丝，内部则是一片沉重近实黑的蓝黑形。面部解剖比平面赛璐璐动画更充分：平滑渐变让脸颊、鼻和嘴有体积，眼和睫毛仍保留清楚动漫风格。构图以安静中央竖向剪影面对一道明亮斜落的光。没有其他人物、物件或可读文字。光承担大部分戏剧性，把普通静姿化为暖辉与冷暗相对的亲近电影式研究。
style_prompt_en: The semi-realistic anime finish pairs stylized expressive features with smooth volumetric modeling and cinematic backlight. A dense cool near-black silhouette occupies the center, while golden light grazes one outer edge and breaks into many fine luminous strands. Warm brown and amber reflections soften the face-like midtones; a dim gray-brown background remains out of focus and unobtrusive. The strongest contrast sits at the rim, not across the entire image. Soft gradients describe subtle planes, and a few crisp lines preserve graphic clarity around the focal details. The crop is close, the pose still, and the surrounding space sparse. Color temperature—gold against blue-black—provides the emotional structure. The surface is polished with slight painterly grain, balancing photographic light with clearly illustrated form.
style_prompt_zh: 半写实动漫完成度把风格化的有表情特征与平滑体积造型、电影式逆光并置。浓密冷近黑剪影占据中央，金光擦过一侧外缘，分散成许多发亮细线。暖褐与琥珀反光柔化中间调，暗灰褐背景保持失焦和不抢眼。最强对比落在轮廓边，而非全画面。柔和渐变描绘细微平面，少数清利线保留焦点细节的图形清晰度。裁切靠近，姿态静止，周围空间稀疏。金色与蓝黑的色温关系构成情绪骨架。表面抛光而略有绘画颗粒，在摄影用光与明确插画形体之间取得平衡。
theme_en: A dark-bobbed young woman in amber glasses catches warm rim light against a dim interior
theme_zh: 戴琥珀色眼镜的深色短发女子在昏暗室内接住暖色轮廓光
name: Semi-realistic anime style
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
